about: The epistola of the formulary “20th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: See how carefully you walk: not as the foolish, but as the wise, redeeming the time, since the days are evil. For this reason do not be imprudent, but understanding what the will of God is. And do not get drunk with wine, in which there is dissipation; rather, be filled with the Holy Spirit, speaking among yourselves with psalms and hymns and spiritual canticles, singing and making music to the Lord in your hearts, always giving thanks to God and the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, submitting to each other in the fear of Christ.

ex.w070: The sentence has no main verb: the participle describes the faithful Paul addresses, subject to one another in the fear of Christ, and works as an exhortation. No separate word expresses its subject, an understood you.
